question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Travel helps you become more broad-minded and you learn something new _______ you go.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**wherever**" means in or to whatever place; no matter where. (जहाँ भी)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "wherever" correctly implies learning something new in any place you go.
 
• The other options: "**So**," "**another**," and "**whomever**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Travel helps you become more broad-minded and you learn something new wherever__ you go.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **So (इसलिए)**: used to introduce a clause with the result or consequence of something.
 
• **Another (एक और)**: an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known.
 
• **Whomever (जिसको भी)**: the objective form of who or whoever.
